description: This PHP source file defines the DataGroupService class within the OrangeHRM system. The class provides methods to retrieve and manage DataGroup permissions, data groups, and API permissions, acting as a service layer between data access objects and higher-level application logic.

classes.name: DataGroupService
classes.description: A service class that provides methods to interact with data group permissions and retrieve permission-related data for authorization purposes within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getDao
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the DataGroupDao instance used by this service.

methods.name: setDao
methods.description: Sets the DataGroupDao instance for this service, allowing dependency injection.

methods.name: getDataGroupPermission
methods.description: Fetches data group permissions based on data group names, user role ID, and permission scope (self or non-self).

methods.name: getDataGroups
methods.description: Retrieves all data groups defined in the system.

methods.name: getDataGroup
methods.description: Retrieves a specific DataGroup object by its name.

methods.name: getApiPermissions
methods.description: Determines the permissions a set of roles has on a specific API class, returning a ResourcePermission object.

methods.name: getDataGroupPermissionCollection
methods.description: Produces a collection of permissions for data groups, merging permissions when multiple data group permissions are present.
